verdict.rationale: Convex's own materials say text search is built in: llms.txt says it "includes ... vector search, text search," the pricing page lists "Text search" on Free & Starter, and the homepage describes search as part of an all-TypeScript, "zero glue" platform. That supports not needing an external service. However, the evidence is only brief feature-list mentions, with no dedicated full-text search documentation. Missing for 10: first-party text-search docs (index definition, query API, relevance and ranking, filtering), and independent or hands-on corroboration that full-text search works well in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run full-text search over my data without wiring up an external search service

citations.quote: Convex also includes a scheduler for running background workflows, file storage for large objects, vector search, text search.
